marco: Heads-up — soft freeze for v2.4.0 starts in 2 hours (2026-09-12 15:00 UTC). If you have docs/version bumps or small non-risky changes, please request a late-merge exception now. Branch: release/v2.4.0.

alisa: Quick Q: I have a changelog-only PR and a minor version bump (pkg version 2.4.0 -> 2.4.1). Safe to ask for exception? CI is green.

marco: Yes, changelog-only + semver patch bumps are allowed under soft freeze if tests are green and you include release notes. Please add the changelog snippet to the PR description and ping here.

devon: @alisa can you confirm there's no schema change, migrations, or platform flags? We should avoid runtime changes during this window.

alisa: confirmed — docs + package.json bump only. No code paths changed. CI passed on main and the release branch.

release-bot: Automated check: PR #5287 flagged as "docs/bump". CI: ✅ all checks. Merge conflicts: none. Can be fast-tracked with an exception.

marco: @release-bot nice. @priya can you take changelog ownership for this release? We need the final release notes collated in the next hour.

priya: Taking it. I'll merge the changelog entries and send final notes to #all-hands after the branch cut.

alisa: Requesting late-merge exception: PR #5287 -> release/v2.4.0. Rationale: docs-only changelog + version bump. CI passes. Testing: local smoke + staging. Rollout plan: immediate post-merge smoke, rollback by reverting cherry-pick if any issue. Cherry-pick command: 
``` 
git checkout release/v2.4.0
git cherry-pick -x abc123def
``` 
marco: Can someone from oncall approve the exception? We need one approver from release leads + oncall to sign off for docs-only.

oncall: Oncall here — looked at the CI logs, smoke looks clean. Approving docs-only exception. :thumbsup:

devon: I'll do a quick review of the PR description and changelog fragment. If it's just the snippet and version, :eyes: from me.

sophie: Minor nit: ensure the changelog entry follows the template (component in brackets, one-sentence blurb). I can patch after merge if needed.

marco: Stack of approvals: devon + oncall + release-bot checks. I'm authorizing the late merge. Reminder: add "release-note: v2.4.1 (docs)" to the PR title.

alisa: Done, title updated and pushed. Thanks! I'll wait for the cherry-pick/merge window.

release-bot: Merge window opened by marco at 2026-09-12T15:12:23Z. Performing fast-path merge into release/v2.4.0. Post-merge hooks will run.

priya: After merge I'll include the changelog lines and a short blurb for the release email.

marco: Good job — everyone, keep an eye on post-merge smoke for the next 30 minutes. If anything flakier than expected appears, we'll revert the cherry-pick and open a rollback PR. :eyes: :shipit:
